answer_1.quote: Current retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) techniques typically employ external retrieval modules... to enhance the generation of subsequent fragments.

answer_2.quote: We adopt multiple metrics to comprehensively evaluate both retrieval and generation performances: • Exact Match (EM): Measures the percentage of predictions that exactly match the ground-truth code. • Edit Similarity (ES): Evaluates the similarity between the generated and ground-truth code fragments using a normalized Levenshtein distance. • Pass@1: It assesses whether the code generated via greedy decoding passes all relevant test cases... • Recall@K: Evaluates the proportion of groundtruth code fragments that are successfully retrieved within the top K results. • MRR@10: Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10...
